card.name: The word body after 'from the'
card.fires_on: The noun naming where something sits or is cleared from, mostly 'body' after 'the' or 'their'. It appears in phrases about a drug or virus being removed from, or present in, the body.

modes.label: Removal from the body
modes.description: 'body' ends a phrase about eliminating or removing a drug from the body, often with dialysis.
modes.example: hemodialysis, not peritoneal dialysis, is recommended to aid in the removal of cefepime from the<< body>>.

modes.label: Present in their body
modes.description: A body-part noun such as system or bodies follows 'in their', describing a virus or mineral level.
modes.example: but the virus is still in their<< system>> and it could be causing damage.

modes.label: Life after removal
modes.description: A possessive plus 'life' follows removed from, outside drug text.
modes.example: the problems are removed from Kamrul’s<< life>>.

card.plain: It fires on the word 'body' when a drug or germ is said to be cleared from or present in the body.
